area_note: Metro Manila, including Bonifacio Global City (BGC) in Taguig, Makati and Quezon City
intro: Most Metro Manila group runs start in the business districts: the Ayala Triangle and Rockwell in Makati, the High Street and 26th Street loops in BGC (which has wide sidewalks), and UP Diliman in Quezon City. Weekday sessions usually go out between 5am and 6:30am, or after work from about 6pm, and the long runs are on weekend mornings. The scene is mostly free, show-up-and-run clubs that post their schedules on Instagram or Facebook, alongside store clubs, paid coaching teams and two long-running hash kennels.

clubs.name: Just Show Up Club
clubs.who: All paces; no tryouts, no pace requirements
clubs.description: A Makati-based community club, set up in 2023 and formerly known as Rockwell Run Club, that runs several times a week across Makati, BGC and Pasig, and has a Saturday chapter in Cebu. Its website schedule is the club's own source of truth for runs that are on, moved or cancelled.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts dated 26 to 29 Oct 2026; weekly schedule on the club website checked 2 Nov 2026

clubs.name: Makati Runners Club

meets.when: Saturdays 7:00am (10K Makati to BGC and back, then breakfast at Salcedo Market)
meets.where: Makati (start point shown to Meetup members)

meets.when: Sundays 6:30am (10K around Ayala Avenue, then breakfast at Legazpi Market)
meets.where: Makati (start point shown to Meetup members)

clubs.description: A Meetup group of about 1,360 members with two weekend 10km runs, each finishing at one of Makati's weekend markets. It is a private group, so meeting points are shown only after joining.
clubs.active_evidence: Meetup events held on 1 Nov 2026 and listed for 7, 8, 14 and 15 Nov 2026

clubs.name: Founders Running Club Manila

meets.where: Single Origin, Opus Mall, Bridgetowne, Quezon City

clubs.who: Founders, investors, tech and creative people; any pace, with pacers; friends, family and pets welcome
clubs.description: The Manila chapter of a networking run club that started in San Francisco in 2022. It holds an easy weekly run followed by coffee and conversation.
clubs.active_evidence: Weekly Meetup events held on 24 and 31 Oct 2026 and listed every Saturday to 28 Nov 2026

clubs.name: runnr club (BGC)
clubs.description: The community club of the runnr running-specialty store chain, which holds weekly group runs with partner clubs in BGC, Cebu and Cagayan de Oro. The page lists its coaching team, which includes USATF-, RRCA- and UESCA-certified coaches.
clubs.active_evidence: Wednesday 6pm run listed in BGC's run-club guide (bgc.com.ph, Jun 2026, updated Sep 2026); weekly-runs schedule live on the club page, checked 2 Nov 2026

clubs.name: 5AM Gang Run Club
clubs.who: Open to all who show up
clubs.description: A large community club with groups in Makati, BGC, Alabang and the north of the metro, which asks runners to leave headphones at home so they can talk. Its Wednesday BGC run is co-hosted with runnr club, whose Manila head coach is one of the club's co-founders.

clubs.name: ASICS Running Club Philippines

meets.when: Weekly sessions at 7:00pm; the day, store and workout are announced in each post
meets.where: ASICS stores, including Glorietta (Makati), Filinvest Mall and Festival Mall (Alabang) and Mall of Asia (Pasay)

clubs.who: Open to all; sign up for each session through the link on the club's Instagram profile
clubs.description: The run club of ASICS Philippines, with coached weekly sessions such as speed intervals and fartlek that start from its stores. BGC's run-club guide also lists a Wednesday 7pm run from ASICS at Two Parkade, BGC.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts dated 22 Sep to 21 Oct 2026, including speed intervals at ASICS Festival Mall on 22 Oct 2026

clubs.name: RWP Run Club (Run with Pat)
clubs.who: All levels, from beginners to marathoners and trail runners
clubs.description: A large club ('Never run alone') with local chapters in Alabang, BGC, Pasay and UP Diliman, among others, plus a chapter in Cebu. Weekly schedules are posted in its Facebook group and on Instagram, and the club is part of the TBR Run Collective.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts dated 23 to 31 Oct 2026, including a club post on 25 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Makati Metro Hash House Harriers (M3H3)

meets.when: Two Sundays a month, mid-afternoon start; each run's date and start time are posted on the run page
meets.where: Varies by run; each run's meeting point, directions and transport are posted on the hareline

clubs.cost: Hash cash varies by run (run #2168: ₱350 men, ₱150 women, ₱50 children, including drinks); check the amount on the run page
clubs.description: A long-running hash kennel that holds trail runs in the usual Hash format. Run locations change, so check the hareline before each run for the meeting point and any shared transport from Makati.
clubs.active_evidence: Run #2168 posted for Sunday 18 Oct 2026 (2:30pm start); run pattern, start time and hash cash described by the M3H3 organisers by email, 30 Sep 2026

clubs.name: Manila Hash House Harriers (MH3)

meets.where: Varies (run #2751: Union Jack Tavern, Legaspi Village, Makati)

clubs.description: Manila's original hash kennel, whose first trail was laid in 1972. It holds a trail run every Monday evening, followed by drinks.

coaches.name: The Bull Runner / TBR Dream Marathon
coaches.offers: First-marathon training programmes (TBR Basecamp, Beginner marathon programmes, TBR Dream Plus) leading to the TBR Dream Marathon, plus strength, yoga and meditation coaching
coaches.credentials: Founder coach: USATF and RRCA running coach; lead coach: World Triathlon Level 2 coach
coaches.description: A Manila-based marathon programme built around a race for first-time marathoners, with a published coaching team. Past participants have formed the TBR Run Collective of clubs.
coaches.active_evidence: Second-chance registration for the 2027 TBR InLife Dream Marathon (22 Jun 2026), draw results (1 Jul 2026) and transfer-policy update (3 Jul 2026) posted on the site

coaches.name: We Ken Run
coaches.offers: Paid group speed sessions, 6-month marathon training (₱37,500), focused training (₱22,500), remote marathon coaching (₱48,000), and a ₱1,000 trial session that counts toward a package
coaches.where: Weekly speed sessions at Filinvest (Alabang), McKinley West near BGC, or UP Diliman, 4:45am to about 7am
coaches.credentials: Head coach: USA Track & Field Level 1
coaches.description: A coached running team, founded during the pandemic, with groups for different paces, beginners included. Registration is online, and walk-ins are not accepted for speed sessions.
coaches.active_evidence: Instagram posts dated 16 Oct to 1 Nov 2026; prices and session details on the site checked 2 Nov 2026
